notes.title: Do you have what it takes to be an Illuminati?
notes.notes:
New Update.

Multiplayer features:

Invite your friends and challenge them in to a car race, or a climb race, solve the puzzles of the temple together and try to unlock the 3 secret levels (one of them is the old version of the temple)
Everything is a puzzle, even the smallest object , when placed in the right place will unlock secrets, some times you have to place 2 or more objects in place.  if you are an initiated just perform your usual rituals, if you are not, you will have to find out what to do and how the temple works. 

but beware, you may open undesired portals and summon ghosts or even zombies.

there is a lot more to discover but i cannot say more.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
Do you have what it takes to be an Illuminati?
Climb
Drive
Fight
Solve Puzzles
Simulate
This update brings a lot of stuff. 
Unlock all the secrets, open portals to new mini game levels,
invite your friends and ask them to help 
 you can have an Illuminati meeting at the temple with your fellow brothers thanks to the multiplayer functions
you can even practice your driving skills, at the end of the game you will have developed strong arms and a strong mind.

notes.title: Big Changes Comming Soon
notes.notes:
The game is evolving

It started as a puzzle but it was too hard, and is not on everyone knowledge how to walk inside an Illuminati lodge.

the puzzle part was removed and leaved the mini game that popped up once the puzzle was solved.

ive seen people trying very hard to solve the puzzles and i cant reveal them how because you have to be an Illuminati member to learn it or to be very intuitive .

Now the game will evolve...

Whats coming:
Multiplayer.
Mini game will appear in another room
The lodge rooms will have the jewels and the items for a full simulation of a lodge
you will be able to get in VR with your friends and simulate a full session. 

The mini slice game will be the same.

we are switching from payed to free, current keys will get a special REWARD

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes: SOME HEADSETS WHERE UNABLE TO COMPLETE THE PUZZLE THAT ALLOWS YOU TO ENTER THE FUN PART OF THE GAME  , SO IT WAS REMOVED. NOW YOU JUST HAVE TO ENTER THE LODGE ROOM WITHOUT HAVING TO DO ANY PREVIOUS STEP.     ITS NOW JUST THE FUN PART WITHOUT ANY MYSTERY
